description: 충청남도_지방하천 정보 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청남도. 하천코드, 하천 명 등을 기준으로 충청남도 행정구역으로 지정된 지방하천의 지류, 하폭, 홍수량, 홍수위를 조회하는 충청남도 지방하천 계획 제원 조회 서비스. Coverage: 충청남도. The portal files it under the publisher 충청남도. Its tags are 홍수, 지방하천, 하천, 환경기상. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2022-11-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
